payload.summary: FOUND BY THE POST-FIX LIVE DRIVE (not by the suite). The narrator is asked for N lines for N scenery events and answers with a JSON array whose POSITION carries the event mapping. The model does not reliably honour that: in the seed-42 live game it wrote about the suspect token moving in the slot belonging to an earlier event, and left a later slot unusable — which fell back to the engine's own sentence. The screen then showed 'The candlestick was discovered in the Dining Room.' immediately followed by 'Candlestick is moved to the Dining Room.' — the same scenery fact twice, one in each voice. Distinct from the critical-event stutter just fixed: that one was the code printing both by design, this one is positional drift in the model's reply. A fix needs the reply to carry per-event identity (an id per line) rather than relying on array order, or one call per event. NOT built: out of scope for the prototype pass and a different mechanism from the four defects in the kickoff.
